occurrences.snippet: # Ṣaṭchidrā (six-hole bānsurī) - in which the work of 12 notes is done with only 6 holes. # Saptachidrā (seven-hole bānsurī) - in which 12 notes are arranged in 7 holes. # Aṣṭachid…
In eight-holed bānsurīs the two Gāndhāras are provided; in nine-holed bānsurīs Pa is held to stand in two places.
